a_question_this_raises_and_does_not_answ.what: the 8-K/A amends the same January event the original 8-K reported - same report date - so C01 counts one leadership change twice.
a_question_this_raises_and_does_not_answ.what_it_is: a question about whether the definition answers the metric's own name. That is a correctness standard, not an implementation choice, and the acceptance register says explicitly that it does not establish it.
a_question_this_raises_and_does_not_answ.why_it_is_not_a_defect_here: the approved definition for C01 is '来源：8-K Item 5.02。输出事件清单：date、accession、item code、brief', which specifies an event list keyed by accession. One entry per filing carrying the item is what it asks for.

both_window_bases: every accepted count is the same under the filing date and the report date, so it does not depend on which reading of the window is taken.

e01_is_the_one_route_this_cannot_read.why: it is the only route with a keyword branch, and reading it means reproducing the route's text scoping. brief_source_priority puts the item code first and a primary-document heading second; a scan over every document in the accession matches 'transaction' in almost any exhibit, which over-counts. Six of the seven windows hold an 8.01 filing, so E01 is accepted only for the one that does not.

the_defect_this_found_was_mine_again.what_it_looked_like: Marriott's C01 and E03 read 2 against a published 3, on a window where every header was saved and two independent copies of the submissions index agree on the filing set.
the_defect_this_found_was_mine_again.what_it_was: the reading filtered on form == '8-K' and Marriott's 2025 window holds one 8-K/A carrying item 5.02, amending the January filing. Including it gives exactly 3.
the_defect_this_found_was_mine_again.why_it_is_worth_writing_down: this is the third time in this block that a reading written to check the route was the thing that was wrong. A quickly written second implementation is less reliable than the route it checks, so every difference gets run to ground before it is called a defect.

what_this_is: the six 8-K event metrics counted from the filings' own SEC headers, for the seven company-periods that deliver them.
